source.body:
<!-- work-order:scenarios/worktrees.md:G-contract -->
## Outcome
`project.setWorktrees`, `project.get`, `agent.worktreeState`, `agent.land`, `agent.discard`, `RailNode.worktree` (docs/worktrees.md)

## Acceptance
Scenarios: G contract
Specification: [scenarios/worktrees.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/worktrees.md)

## Scope
`crates/contracts/**` with `contracts/generated/**`, and every `RailNode` literal (the webview fixtures, `seeds.ts`, the e2e tests)

## Preserve
`cargo test -p contracts`, `just check`

## Dependencies
after the worktrees docs PR, A16 (the contract PR adds `worktree_unlanded` to `rail.remove`, which A16 introduces) and T8's implementation merge, because all three edit `crates/contracts/**` and `seeds.ts`; committee approval (rule 4)

## Delivery
No implementation PR linked yet.

## Queue
Key: G-contract
Priority: 100
Migration state: unspecified

Imported from the Work table. The issue-backed queue is being installed; this issue does not create a second Builder. Completion requires delivery evidence, not a matching test name.

goals.statement: `crates/contracts` declares the methods `project.setWorktrees` ({on, check} -> null), `project.get` (null -> {worktrees: {on, check}}), `agent.worktreeState` ({id} -> {ahead, behind, dirty}), `agent.land` ({id} -> {base}) and `agent.discard` ({id} -> null), as docs/worktrees.md's Contract change table specifies, and `contracts/generated/methods.ts` regenerated from it matches with no diff.
goals.observer: On main: `cargo test -p contracts` passes, regenerating `contracts/generated/` gives no diff, and `contracts/generated/methods.ts` lists the five methods with those param/result types.

goals.statement: `RailNode` carries `worktree: {path, branch, base} | null`, and every `RailNode` literal (webview fixtures, `apps/desktop/src/testing/seeds.ts` via `testing/nodes.ts`, the e2e tests) compiles against it.
goals.observer: On main: `contracts/generated/agent/RailNode.ts` has `worktree: Worktree | null` and `Worktree.ts` has path, branch and base; `just check` passes, which type-checks the webview and e2e callers.

goals.statement: `rail.remove` refuses with `CONFLICT` and a message starting `worktree_unlanded: ` when removing the node would lose unlanded work, and the G2 codes apply to `agent.spawn`/`rail.startDoor`, all using existing `rpc::code` constants, with `crates/rpc` left unchanged.
goals.observer: On main: `cargo test -p agents` passes the worktree scenario tests that assert `code::CONFLICT` and the `worktree_unlanded:` prefix (crates/agents/tests/scenarios/landing.rs, worktrees.rs), and `crates/rpc` has no new code constant.
